Memory champion Nelson Dellis sits down with Danny Jones to explain an old Greek method for building a very strong memory. Dellis is known for winning memory contests in the United States. The method at the center of the talk is the memory palace, a trick that dates back to ancient Greece.

Dellis walks through how the method works, step by step, in plain terms a beginner can try. He links the old Greek practice to the skills he uses in contests today. Listeners get both the history of the trick and a set of habits they can test on names, lists, and facts of their own.
